_meta.purpose: Curated local TV-station and newspaper RSS feeds used by the Near You / Across Your State source picker. Bundled because no free location-aware news API gave us reliable hyperlocal coverage; see commit history for the rabbit hole.

<state-abbrev>.<lowercase-city>: [ array of entries serving that city specifically ]

entry.name: Display label shown in the picker (include city + outlet)
entry.rss: Direct RSS feed URL (validate it returns content before adding!)
entry.site: Public-facing landing page (used for the favicon and click-through)

howToAdd: 1. Find a candidate RSS URL for the local outlet (TV station, paper, etc.).
2. Verify it returns items via the proxy: curl -s 'https://happening-now.net/v1/rss/raw?url=<urlencoded>' | grep -c '<item'  -- if 0, skip.
3. Add an entry under states.<XX>.<lowercase-city> for hyperlocal, or states.<XX>._state for statewide.
4. Keep entries sorted alphabetically within each city array.
5. Lookups are case-insensitive: getStationsForGeo({ city:'Jackson', state:'MI' }) finds states.MI.jackson.
